title: Choose Plasma's landing direction
question: Compare the three rendered directions. Select one, add a steer, or ask for a fresh set. The current landing page is unchanged.

options.label: A. Reference
options.thesis: A light, documentation-inspired landing page with useful margin navigation and product proof close to each claim.
options.viewport: Left navigation rail; a concise two-line engine statement; the SQL workspace below. Full preview: http://127.0.0.1:3103/reference.html
options.risk: Highest technical clarity, but less visually expressive.

options.label: B. Workspace
options.thesis: A dark neutral page that makes the application itself the dominant first impression.
options.viewport: Compact centered introduction above a nearly full-width workspace; engine views switch in place. Full preview: http://127.0.0.1:3103/workspace.html
options.risk: Strongest product presence, but closest to familiar developer-tool marketing.

options.label: C. Editorial
options.lineage: Understated product brochures and editorial composition
options.thesis: An asymmetric composition balances a narrow headline with a close-up of the editor, then explains the engines through typography rather than cards.
options.viewport: Headline and action on the left; a tall editor-and-results crop on the right. Full preview: http://127.0.0.1:3103/editorial.html
options.risk: Most distinctive composition; the whole workspace is less visible at first glance.
